name: codex-manager
description: Manage Codex across connected PCs from your browser: remote sessions, files, Git, terminals, accounts, quota, task boards, and Auto Resume.

codexManager.codexAppRestartMode.markdownDescription: Restart the running desktop app automatically or ask each time.

codexManager.codexAppRestartEnabled.markdownDescription: Manage desktop app restarts after account switches.

codexManager.dashboardTheme.markdownDescription: Choose a dashboard theme; `auto` follows VS Code.

codexManager.privacyMode.markdownDescription: Hide account identities in all dashboards and account details.

codexManager.displayLanguage.markdownDescription: Choose the language for Codex Manager.

codexManager.autoRefreshMinutes.markdownDescription: Check all account quotas every N minutes; `0` turns polling off and `1`–`4` use `5`.

codexManager.autoRefreshCurrentMinutes.markdownDescription: Check current account quota every N minutes; `0` turns polling off.

codexManager.tokenHistoryRetentionDays.markdownDescription: Legacy setting retained for compatibility. Verified VS Code usage is kept in SQLite across account removal; chart queries load only the selected date window.

codexManager.dailyTokenUsageIntervalMinu.markdownDescription: Minimum minutes between automatic token history checks; server retry delays still apply.

codexManager.dailyTokenUsageEnabled.markdownDescription: Save daily usage at the selected interval and fill missing chart history; saved usage stays when off.

codexManager.usageHistoryRetentionDays.markdownDescription: Legacy setting retained for compatibility. New quota history is not recorded.

codexManager.cliIntegrationEnabled.markdownDescription: Workspace: add chats and terminals to the dashboard.

codexManager.taskBoardEnabled.markdownDescription: Show the compact project task board with Idea, Planned, Running, and Completed columns.

codexManager.apiAccessEnabled.markdownDescription: Allow generated Bearer tokens to call the local dashboard API.

codexManager.autoSwitchEnabled.markdownDescription: Switch accounts when current quota reaches either configured limit.

codexManager.autoSwitchWaitForSessionsEn.markdownDescription: Wait for running chats before automatic switches or resets; manual switching stays available.

codexManager.autoSwitchReloadWindowEnabl.markdownDescription: Automatically reload VS Code after an account switch changes the active account.

codexManager.autoResumeEnabled.markdownDescription: With Auto Switch on, open unfinished parent chats in official Codex conversation tabs after a VS Code restart, then resume when ready. Paused goals stay paused.

codexManager.crossWindowAccountModeEnabl.markdownDescription: Experimental: use a separate account in each VS Code window.

codexManager.autoSwitchHourlyThreshold.markdownDescription: Switch when remaining 5-hour quota reaches this percentage or less.

codexManager.autoSwitchWeeklyThreshold.markdownDescription: Switch when remaining weekly or monthly quota reaches this percentage or less.

codexManager.autoSwitchRefreshAllBeforeS.markdownDescription: Check enabled account quotas before alerts or automatic switches.

codexManager.autoResetEnabled.markdownDescription: Use an available reset credit when every enabled account is out of quota.

codexManager.autoResetWeeklyThreshold.markdownDescription: Use a reset credit when weekly or monthly quota reaches this percentage or less.

codexManager.autoSwitchLockMinutes.markdownDescription: Keep the current account for this many minutes; `0` disables the default lock.

codexManager.codexAppPath.markdownDescription: Choose the desktop app location or leave empty for auto-detect.

codexManager.codexCliPath.markdownDescription: Choose the Codex program or leave empty for auto-detect.

codexManager.quotaWarningEnabled.markdownDescription: Warn when current account quota falls below either configured limit.

codexManager.quotaWarningThreshold.markdownDescription: Warn below this percentage of remaining 5-hour quota.

codexManager.quotaWarningWeeklyThreshold.markdownDescription: Warn below this percentage of remaining weekly or monthly quota.

codexManager.quotaGreenThreshold.markdownDescription: Show green from this percentage of remaining quota.

codexManager.quotaYellowThreshold.markdownDescription: Show yellow from this percentage until green; lower values appear red.

codexManager.encryptedSyncEnabled.markdownDescription: Share encrypted account reservations between PCs.

codexManager.fullCrossPcAccountSyncEnabl.markdownDescription: Share encrypted account sessions and tokens between PCs; off keeps logins local.

codexManager.webDashboardEnabled.markdownDescription: Open a browser dashboard on this PC; set a shared password before allowing remote access.

codexManager.webSocketServerEnabled.markdownDescription: Connect systems through the configured shared dashboard server.

codexManager.cloudflaredDomain.markdownDescription: Optional HTTPS dashboard address for other PCs; set a shared password before sharing.

codexManager.encryptedSyncClaimAllAccoun.markdownDescription: Reserve every enabled account for this PC; off reserves only the current account.

codexManager.encryptedSyncVsCodeHeartbea.markdownDescription: Choose the minimum interval between VS Code Settings Sync saves.

scripts.compile: npm run typecheck:webview && npm run build:webview && tsc -p ./
scripts.package: npm run compile && vsce package --no-yarn --dependencies && node tools/verify-vsix-layout.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck:webview && tsc -p ./
scripts.test:ui: npm run compile && node tools/check-responsive-ui.mjs && node tools/check-browser-notifications.mjs && node tools/check-offline-ui.mjs
